###  CRPA Antenna Characterization
**SDR Lead | Harvey Mudd Collge**  
*August 2026 – Present (Team of 7)*

Leading Software Defined Radio (SDR) signal processing to test and characterize a Controlled Reception Pattern Antenna (CRPA) for anti-jamming performance. 

* **Key Focus:** Return loss, mutual coupling, element/array radiation patterns, axial ratios, null testing, Jamming-to-Noise ($J/N$) ratio, and beam steering.
* **Tools & Tech:** SDRs, Vector Network Analyzer (VNA), MATLAB/Python, RF Testing

###  Autonomous Underwater Robot
**Hardware & Systems Lead**  
*Team of 4*

Designed and fabricated an autonomous robot capable of both surface navigation and controlled underwater diving to perform bathymetric floor mapping and environmental sampling.

* **Key Focus:** Sensor integration (sonar depth measurement, pressure, temperature), ballast/surface motion control, and 3D floor contour generation.
* **Tools & Tech:** Sonar Processing, Microcontrollers, 3D Mapping, Sensor Fusion

###  Smart High-CADR Indoor Air Purifier
**LILAQ Summer Undergraduate Researcher**  


Engineered a custom DIY indoor air purification system that outperforms commercial off-the-shelf units in Clean Air Delivery Rate (CADR) at a significantly lower cost.

* **Key Focus:** Cost reduction and ongoing phase-2 integration of a particulate matter (PM2.5) sensor and microcontroller for automated fan speeds.
* **Tools & Tech:** PM Sensors, Microcontrollers, System Prototyping, C/C++
